verdict.rationale: Circle's own docs describe official SDKs: Web and Mobile SDKs (Android and iOS) for Wallets alongside REST APIs, and Bridge Kit, a lightweight SDK for CCTP transfers in a few lines of code. The CLI page also references the multiple SDKs it can replace. Missing for 10: evidence of server-side language SDKs (e.g. Node/Python), SDK reference depth or coverage across other products (Gateway, CPN, StableFX), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
